book.name: Mak
book.title: God ol wai ol na tongwo ha i Mak bol engwo dimia

content: Yuda singaba hobi kene ongwo hobi kina Yisas si golala dire ha hongwo ha

Ena hamen haung sutani wai sinangure erin bir u mala namia. Erin bir iwe, yal kun sipi sipi sikere, te breti u bir hongwo ne mongwo haung u pa dinangure, homena bir ke nenamia. Nenangwo haung u mala ongwi. Ena Yuda ha maing singaba God krehaman ha nir sitongwo hobi kina molere, Yisas kul si haning sire, sigolala dire, nomani sire, hol wa dungwi.
“Erin habang iwe, ari miki weni homena ne monangure, nan Yisas haning sinaminba, ari hobi kura bir bol na tenamua,” dire han uning si olungwi.
Al ta wel garu dire Yisas bil tongwo ha

Homa Saimon hakubi dongure Yisas awai ol tongwo yali Betani ke pangwi. Ke pangwo oo ala iwe, Yisas pi bol bani ami di molere, homena ne mongwi. Mongure al ta wel niring, kunu wai ungwo, tobo bir weni bongwo, i ungwi. Urere, grang si pa dire, garu dire, Yisas breng bani bil tongwi.
Tomba, ari hobi nigi de pire, ha diria olere, “Wel niring i talongwo gogo bil tome?
Tobo bir teti kina inaminga irai, ari talhan a nekungwo hobi ebir si tenaminga irawe.”
Direre al i kura ha ditongwi. Tomba Yisas yu ditongwi, “A, kura ha ditekio. Al i nin hang pangwo omia.

Ongwiwe, tal wai weni ol na tongwo i hankino? Yal bina hobi kina ereho moli pirere, emgi talta aki di te monanga bani monania. Na kina moli ubilgarai para wai simia, emgi hon tal ta aki di na tenan mo? Tekinania.
Omaga al i wel bil na tongwiwe, golalga haung mala umia, na ari yulagi engwo bani na man wu enangwo ipire, yu ol na tomua.
Tal ol tega ha maing ganba ganba i para kunu benangure, al tal ol na tongwiwe, di tibi olangure, ari para nomani si pinamua. Na ha pangwo meri di ni teiwa” dungwi.
Yal Yuda Yisas bai tal sire singaba hobi teralua dungwo ha

Ena Yisas grang wine ongwo yal ta Yudas Iskeriot ha i pirere, pi Yuda ha maing oo singaba yu di tongwi, “Na Yisas gamahobo molia, sigonanga haung mala unangwiwe, na yali monangwo bani di tibi ol ni teralua.”
Dungure Yuda singaba hobi wai pirere, “Di tibi ol na tenanga, tobo moni ni teralua.” Dungure pirere, bai tal sirala dire, homaulung kwi mole han mongwi.
Yisas gamahobi kina Pasoba erin homena nongwo ha

Ena homena breti u bir hongwo nere mongwo habang iwe, erin bir weni ta u tibi ongwi. Ongure, kun sipi sipi yalkun ta si kere nongwi. Nomba grang wine ongwo hobi Yisas yu ditongwi, “Na yalhobi pirere homena makena a kun ole enamne?”
Dungure ena Yisas yal sutani bai nu si olere, yu ditongwi, “Ni yasuri oo malgi po. Pi pa dinanga, yal ta nir hol ire unangwo bangi hanania.
Hanangiwe, doling bol po. Ongere yali oo ala nangwo irai oo hong yal sirin bol piro. “Tisa grang wine ongwo hobi kina homena nerala dimia, weran ta ya dim mo, dikime?” di piro.
Oo hong yal i weran ta i tibi ol ni tenangwo irai, ala pirere, homena akun onanua.”
Yu ditongure yasuri ere pirere, pi malgi pa dungwi. Pa dungure Yisas ha ditongwo meri u tibi ongure, yasuri homena nenangwo a kun ol e mongwi.
Mongure pudungwo Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi kina ungwi.
Urere bol bani ami di molere, homena ne momba, Yisas yu dungwi, “Ni yalhobi monga sina i yal ta na bai tal sinania. Ha weni kara di ni teiwa.”
Dungure yalhobi gumang bani nin han iriala olere, yal tani tani aire, “Na yo? Na yo? I ta olkiralua.”
Dungure Yisas yu ditongwi, “Ni yalhobi monga sina i yal ta onania. Onanga yal iwe, pere bala tani homena ereho nir bole nobilua.

Ha maing mining ganing bol engwo meri irawe, Ari Wang Weni na golalga pamia. Na Ari Wang Weni irawe, na bai tal sinanga yal i, emgi gul bir weni pinania. Aang ta kul ekinangworai, wai panamba,” dungwi.
Yisas gamahobi breti wain kina tongwo ha
Ena homena ne mongure, Yisas breti ta irere, God homena na tenga wai pir ni teiwa dire, a du dire, yalhobi tongwi.
Terere yu ditongwi, “Na gauna miing ni teiya neiyo” dungwi.

Direre wain nir ta irere, God ereyu ditere yalhobi tongwi. Tongure nongwi. Nongure, “Nir iwe, na nan algi dimia Na nomani guwa si ni teiya. Ari miki weni God bolo gumang puli ire u tani nama dire, na nan algi u mena namia.
Na nir wain iwe, hon ta nekiralba, emgi God kene ongwo bani pi molere, hon neralua. Na haweni kara di ni teiwa.”
Dungure ul geral ta di wai sirere, Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi kina ere Olib hamen hul i ongwi.
Yisas Pita mobeng hal wa na tenanua dungwo ha

Pi mongure Yisas gamahobi yu ditongwi, “Ha maing mining ta yu pamia. God kun sipi sipi kene ongwo yali sigonangure, kun sipi sipi hobi te ususu namua. Yu di emiraya, ni yalhobi iwe, na aidolere, te nania.(Sek 13:7)
Nanba, te na golere hon airalgiwe, homa e ni tere, pi Galili molalua.”
Dungure Pita yu dungwi, “A, yalhobi te namba, na ni ai dolekiralua.”
Dungure Yisas Pita yu ditongwi, “Omaga ginangwo i hoale gin sutani be dinangure, kul pirere, na hana gin sui tai dire di kul sinanua.”
Yu dimba, Pita nimni mole yu dungwi, “A, ni gonangi na para golalua. Ni hani ta di kul sikiralua,” dungwi. Dungure yalhobi Pita dungwo meri doling bole dungwi.
Yisas irang God ha di terala dire Getsemani u sina ongwo ha
Ena yalhobi Getsemani ai u pa dungwi. Pa direre, Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi yu ditongwi, “Ni yalhobi timi molo. Na God ha di terala oiwa.”
Direre, Pita, Yems, Yon ya su hobi aule ire ongwi. Pirere, Yisas yong sina ering bai tabile hoho mo ungure, nomani si gogo olungwi.
Olere, “Na yona sina i erin bai tabile dimia, golalga mere piria, hon mole han molo.”
Direre obilga ulubi pire, ikwi bole, God yu ditongwi, “Nabe, ni aki di na terala di pinanga, aki di na to.
Tenanga omaga gul piralga haung u tibi ta hunama di piriwa. Piriba talhan hobi para muru ni hobang monia. Na hana ta paikima. Ni hani pamia, gran wine olalua,” dungwi.
Di pisolere, ere yalhobi mongwo bani pire hangure, ul pai mongwo hangwi. Hanere Yisas Pita yu ditongwi, “Saimon, ni ul talongwo pane? Hon molo di ni tegarai molkino?
Seten ni kraun sire kela kul ni tenangwo pir tekinga pire, ni ul paikirere, God ha moni moni di te molo. Nomani si pinga kulang pangwo yu olalua di pinba, gaun oun dongwo timawe.”
Di tere, hon ere mena pirere, God ha homa ditongwo meri hon ditongwi.
Di te pisole ure, hangure, yasu hobi omeling oun dongure, ul pai mongwo hangwi. Hangure Yisas wi dungwo pirere, gintani hon molere, gai golere, pir uning si mongwi.

Mongure Yisas hon ere mena pire urere, “Ni yalhobi ul pare uning sire mono? Ena para monia. Na si gonama diga haung irai u mala umia. Ari Wang Weni na irawe, na haning sirere, ari hana yamoni mongwo hobi na tenangwo pamia, han molega.
Aire namna pano. Na bai tal sinangwo yal omaga umia hano,” dungwi.
Yudas Yisas bai tal sire kiang hobi tongwo ha

Ena dire mongure Yisas grang wine ongwo yal ta Yudas, u pa dungwi. Dungure ari miki weni kina ereho ungwi. Ungwo hobi ure, Yuda ha maing singaba ya, ha nir sitongwo ya, kene ongwo hobi nu si olungure, di baina ya, kuba ire ungwi.
Ungure bai tal sinangwo yali yu dungwi, “Na homa pirere, yal ta guma mu diralga yali han sinania. Sirere kene ole aule ire po,” dungwi.
Ena Yudas homa u Yisas mongwo bani pa dire, “Tisao” dire guma mu dungwi.
Dungure ari hobi para pirere, Yisas han sungwi.
Sire aule ire nala di omba, Yisas grang wine ongwo yal ta di baina ire, Yuda singaba boi honagi yal ta di sungure, kraung bol bali sungwi.
Sungwo hanere Yisas yu ditongwi, “Ni yalhobi na na han sirala dire, di kuba ire unia. Ungiwe, yal ta homena kuni nongwo han sirala dire un mo?
Homa ya monga habang na kina ha maing oo ala ereho molere, ha di ni tega pinga irawe, na han sikiniraya. Ha maing mining ganing homa di engwo irai, omaga u tibi omia hano.”
Yu dungure gamahobi Yisas aidolere, te ongwi.
Yagalan ta te ongwo ha
Omia yagaling ta apalapo pege ta pirere, Yisas ongwo mobing holi doling bol ongwi. Ongure ari hobi pi arere, han sirala di omba,
te omia, apalapo kula si ingure, yoluwai bolo ongwi.
Kiang hobi Yisas auli Kaunsil mongwo bani pire ha hol ol tongwo ha
Ena yalhobi Yisas aule irere, Yuda ha maing singaba ke pangwo malgi ongwi. Ongure krehaman ha nir si tongwo hobi ire, singaba tau ire, ha maing kene ongwo hobi ire dire, u ku bole mongwi.
Momia Pita Yisas ongwo mobing hol i doling bol pirere, ulubi naa di mongwi. Molere soldia er kwi nu mongwo yal tau, endo pir mongwo bani Pita ami di mongwi.
Ena Yuda ha maing oo singaba, te u ku bongwo hobi, Yisas si gonama dire ha hol ongwi. Omba, ha dungwo hobo kungwi.
Kumia ari miki weni airere, hasu dire kela kul tongure, ha ta u kunu homa.
Homia yal tau aire ha gogo ditongwi,
“Ena yali yu dimiraya, Yuda ha maing oo bir na gintani tulere, ari habang sui tai dire ari oo kengwo tali kekiralia. Hon keralua dungworai, na pir mominua.”
Dimba, ha ere u kunu homa.
Yu ongure Yuda ha maing oo singaba bir weni u sina aire molere, Yisas yu ditongwi, “Ha di mere si ni tongwo i ni mong di tere molkino?”
Dimba, Yisas pir uning si ole mongwi. Mongure singaba i hon yu sirin bol tongwi, “Ni maa e tominga yal God irawe, wang Kraist ni mon mo?”
Dungure Yisas yu dungwi, “Owa, na moliwa. Ari Wang Weni na irawe, God na i aleng weni hol i olangure molalia. Mol i pire emgi kwahawa bolimbani ya ime uralga hananua.”
Dungure singaba i nigi de pirere, nin galsina ongwo aulu dire, yu ditongwi.
“God gaung ha sungwo pingiwe, para wai simia. Gonam mo, golkinam mo? Ni ari hobi nin pinanga meri do.” Dungure yalhobi grang para mu dire, “Yal i pring bir pai tomia, gonamua” dungwi.
Direre yal tau ebil si tere, apalapo ta irere, omeling bani to holere, “Na ni siminia, hana dalo” dungwi. Ena soldia er kwi nu mongwo hobi urere, gaung bane bani di dagi sungwi.
Pita Yisas na hankiwa di kirulu dungwo ha
Ena Pita maini u sina i mongwi. Mongure ha maing oo singaba honagi ama ta wiyala ongwi.
Omba, Pita endo pir mongwo hanere, tene han terere, “Ni Nasarete hong yal, Yisas, gamahobo monua,” ditongwi.
Ditongure Pita ha di kul sirere, “Haniraba dinga pir kun olekiwe,” dungwi. Direre ere maini nala dire hona i ongwi. Ongure hoale be dungwi.
Dungure ama i hon urere, Pita hanere, ari mala mongwo hobi ditongwi, “Yal ya yali gamahobo momua” dungwi.
“A. Haniraba dinga pirkiwe.” Dungure emgi ari mala mongwo hobi Pita hon sirin bol tongwi, “Ni Galili yal monia, Yisas gamahobi weni kara monua.”
Dungure Pita God maulung bani di yulang bolere, “Na ha pangwo dikiralga God na sigonaamia. Yali weni kara hankiwe.”

Dungure hoale ti be dungwi. Dungure Pita pirere, “Yal hoale gin sutani be dirala di onangwo, na hana gin sui tai dire di kul si na tenanua,” Yisas yu ditongwo irai i kraung bani ere nomani si pir mongwi. Molere, min bile yare simile hai me mongwi.
